topic.source_contract: Green Belt boundary, purpose assessment, grey-belt definition, sustainable location, inappropriate-development test, golden rules, permission, obligations and delivery evidence

scope_guards: Green Belt designation is not treated as an automatic refusal for every proposal.
Grey-belt identification is not treated as automatic allocation, release or permission.
Previously developed land is not treated as grey belt without the current policy tests.
A Green Belt assessment is not treated as a planning decision.
Housing need is not treated as satisfaction of all paragraph 155 conditions.
Golden Rules policy is not treated as secured affordable housing or infrastructure.
A committee resolution is not treated as issued planning permission.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary, policy tests, decision, obligations, construction and delivery evidence.
row_checks: Current adopted Green Belt boundary required
Exact parcel and boundary relationship required
Current local plan and review status required
Exact PDL status and exclusions required
Housing or other need policy condition required
Appropriate, exception or inappropriate route required
Spatial and visual openness assessment required
Applicable affordable housing and infrastructure rules required
Current national limitations and evidence required
Issued decision, conditions and expiry required
Affordable homes, infrastructure and green space delivered required
Current combined Green Belt evidence unresolved
